+# irrops-ml
+
+Disruption recovery: optimisation runs produce candidate solutions, which planners compare and open on the solution pages.
+
+## Language
+
+**Open solution**:
+The solution currently shown as a Gantt; the one the tab's URL points at.
+_Avoid_: selected solution, current solution
+
+**Marked solution**:
+The solution the user has picked on the decks to compare across them, without opening it.
+_Avoid_: selected solution, highlighted solution
